senses.gloss: f. (נָצַל; cmp. נִיצּוֹלֶת) refuse, threshed-out halms, husks &c.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 9b">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 119a:7">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>כמ׳ שאין בה דגן</he> Var. lect. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes) like husks without grain.—Pl. <he>מְצוּלוֹת</he>.
